# Task inventory

**21 tasks** generated by the pipeline (`build_task.sh <seed> <easy|medium|hard>`), every one built on the in-image font pipeline so its reference is reachable by the agent. Each is a self-contained Harbor task.

**Distribution:** 6 easy · 7 medium · 8 hard (tail-weighted). All ≥5 pages. Mean reward by tier and full results in [`evaluation.md`](evaluation.md).

## Variety (the generator samples orthogonal axes per seed — see [`../ideas.md`](../ideas.md) I6)

**Site types:** online store / e-commerce (3), education / online course (3), nonprofit / charity (3), travel / hospitality booking (3), fintech / banking (2), fitness / gym / wellness (2), food delivery / restaurant (1), music / artist / event (1), personal portfolio / studio (1), news / editorial magazine (1), real estate / property listings (1)

**Aesthetics:** playful (5), brutalist (5), luxury / elegant (3), corporate clean (3), dark techy (2), Swiss / international minimalism (2), retro / Y2K (1)

## How to run a task

Each task dir holds `task.toml`, `instruction.md`, `environment/` (Dockerfile + agent input screenshots + grader code), `tests/` (verifier + hidden reference), and `solution/` (oracle).

```bash
# from inside a task dir — runs Opus 4.7, scores it, writes the reward
cd website-rl-eval-harbor/eval-pear-easy
../../venv/bin/harbor run -c run.agent.yaml      # environment.type: modal
# local Docker instead of Modal:
HARBOR_ENV_TYPE=docker ../../venv/bin/harbor run -c run.agent.yaml
# validate the grader ceiling (oracle ≈ 1.0):
../../venv/bin/harbor run -c run.oracle.yaml
```

> The raw per-trial job outputs (agent trajectories + renders) are large and git-ignored; the distilled rewards + per-dimension scores live in [`../results/`](../results/).
